scientific_integrity: Proof and numerical verifier are included. No empirical check is treated as infinite proof. Priority conclusions are best-knowledge literature comparisons, not absolute novelty certificates.
scientific_limitations: Rank-one fixed-seed exact-arithmetic theorem. The Gaussian formula concerns two distinct positive eigenvalues and identity f only; spectral norm, block sketches and floating-point implementations are not addressed. Equivalent prior formulation remains possible.
title: Pathwise Frobenius descent and a Gaussian mean-rate gap in rank-one funNyström
